question: How does abstaining from food by day affect death from aging?
premises: Non-eating by day is prescribed as the means.
Death from aging is the target.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death from aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may imply going to or overcoming death depending on idiom
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death from aging.
